newsitem.title: ESTONIA: ESTONIA-MONTHLY INTERBANK RATES RISE SLIGHTLY.
newsitem.headline: ESTONIA-MONTHLY INTERBANK RATES RISE SLIGHTLY.

text.p: The weighted average rate of monthly overnight loans increased by a 0.05 percentage point with other rates remaining stable, the Estonian central bank said.
The central bank's averages on monthly interbank rates rose by a 0.05 percentge point.
Wednesday's fixing for the talibor/talibid was 6.43/5.43 percent compared to last week's 6.38/5.38 percent.
"There is still some nervousness in the market which started from the first day of the month with most banks borrowing earlier than they would have several months ago," said one dealer.
The average rate of overnight loans on the interbank market was 3.53 percent, stable compared to last week.
The weekly rate was stable at 4.85/3.85 and the three month rate was also steady at 8.07/7.02 percent
